author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Highland Haven launch trailer for this upcoming cozy, idle, desktop companion game about taking care of Highland cows and restoring your own personal Scottish farm! The game lives at the bottom of your screen, freeing you up to work, shop online, or do other things on your computer while it runs. Through caring for your cows you will gain resources like milk and hair to process into goods to sell. Using the money you earn, you can adopt more cows, upgrade your cottage, purchase crafting stations, hire automation helpers, and customize your cows and cottage with cute designs! 

Highland Haven will be available on PC.
title: Highland Haven - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Nevada Motor Speedway Track Trailer for Endurance Motorsport Series, a simulation racing series developed by KT Racing. Players will take to the track with the upcoming Nevada Motor Speedway, a fictional track built to aid drivers. The Nevada Motor Speedway Track for Endurance Motorsport Series is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
See the Nevada Motor Speedway in the Endurance Motorsport Series. This track guide breaks down the 5.1 km layout and technical turns.

This video provides a detailed look at the Nevada Motor Speedway, covering the essential track statistics you need to know. We examine the 600m pit lane and the 10-turn circuit design to help you prepare for your next race. Whether you are a fan of sim racing or just curious about the Endurance Motorsport Series, this footage demonstrates how the game handles real-world physics and environmental variables like humidity.

Experience the track in both day and night cycles to see
title: Endurance Motorsport Series - Official Nevada Motor Speedway Track Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
A world shattered by forbidden knowledge. Learn about the story and get a look at gameplay from Sword Sage: Awakening in this trailer for the upcoming action RPG rooted in Chinese mythology and folklore. Follow San Niang, a disciple of the Yuangong Sect, as she battles deadly Yaoguai, masters ancient martial arts, and uncovers the truth behind a catastrophe that changed Jiannandao forever. Sword Sage: Awakening will be available on PC.

Sword Sage: Awakening pulls players into the fantastical world of Jiannandao, a land forever changed by the Supreme White Gibbon Sage. After drunkenly unearthing long forbidden texts containing divine power and knowledge that humans were never meant to have, the lands became plagued with relentless natural disasters and monstrous infestations. The people of Jiannandao have learned to survive by forging advanced technologies to fight back against the onslaught of suffering they face.

#SwordSageAwakening #Gaming #IGN
title: Sword Sage: Awakening - Official Story Trailer
